mechanism: Sulfasalazine may increase perphenazine levels through CYP450 inhibition and competition for protein binding, while perphenazine increases risk of photosensitivity and gastrointestinal effects that sulfasalazine also causes.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation); consider dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic if excessive effects occur; counsel patient on sun protection and GI precautions.
